# Credit Policy Overview

This document explains how credit files are reviewed at Demo Mortgage Co. It sets out the scope of the review, who owns each part of it, and how records are kept.

## Scope of Review

This section describes how the review of a file is handled at Demo Mortgage Co. by the people who own the work. Each step is recorded in the file so that a later reviewer can follow what was decided and why. Staff refer to a customer only by loan number and never copy personal details into notes or chat tools. When a rule is unclear, the person handling the file asks the policy owner before proceeding with the request. Decisions are made against the written policy and not against habit or memory of earlier files. A second person checks the work whenever the file moves from one stage to the next stage in the workflow. Any gap in the documents is listed as an open item and the borrower is told plainly what is still needed. Open items are tracked until each one is closed, waived through the exception process, or the file is withdrawn. Records are kept in the file system of record and are not stored in personal folders or in messages. Owners review this guidance on a regular schedule and update it whenever a related policy changes. Plain language is preferred in every message so that the reader can act on it without further explanation. Anything that cannot be resolved at the front line is escalated to the next role with a short written summary. The scope covers every file received through any channel. The reviewer signs off only when the file is complete, consistent, and ready for the next stage to begin. If circumstances change after sign off, the file is reopened and the checks are repeated from the start.
